exposure: systematic promotion of twin vaginal delivery
cohort: 1,574 patients delivering twins, 897 of whom were included in the analysis (pregnancies at or beyond 24 weeks of gestation without contraindications to labor, prior uterine surgery, or fetal demise/anomaly)
finding: While the rate of twin vaginal birth increased after the implementation of a quality improvement initiative promoting twin vaginal delivery, this increase was attributed to secular trend and not the intervention itself.
mod_finding: Although the overall rate of twin vaginal deliveries increased, the study found no significant difference in the rate of change before and after the intervention aimed at promoting vaginal birth.
